about: Intended differences from the reference inventory, per screen (docs/VISUAL_REDESIGN.md 8.6 step 3). Each change removes a run of reference controls and puts its insert in their place, or inserts before a reference control; with insertWhen, the inserted controls are expected exactly when that selector matches a visible element on the screen. Edited only by the wave's owner of scripts/verify, signed off by the wave's integrator, with the same delta recorded in 8.6.

deltas.reason: The platform themes are retired (OD-7) and their block becomes the Icon pack picker (OD-4); Modern is the first color scheme (OD-7).

changes.reason: Platform Theme block removed; the Icon pack section takes its place once R1-FOUNDATION renders it
